description: Fix Profile Extends Resolution, Source Freshness & Profile Discovery — Fix sparse-checkout expansion for extends chains, add automatic source cache freshness with configurable TTL, fix profile discovery to show all available profiles, and replace silent error swallowing with hard errors

userStories.title: Expand ClonedSource interface and add expandSparseCheckout function
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the git clone infrastructure to expose cache path info and provide a function to expand sparse-checkout, so the profile chain resolver can add parent profile paths on demand.
acceptanceCriteria: ClonedSource interface in packages/core/src/sources/git-clone.ts includes cachePath: string (git repo root) and sparseCheckout: boolean
Both return paths in cloneGitSource() (cache-hit and fresh-clone) populate cachePath and sparseCheckout fields
New exported function expandSparseCheckout(cachePath: string, additionalPaths: string[]): Promise<void> added to git-clone.ts
expandSparseCheckout uses 'git sparse-checkout add <path>' (not 'set') to preserve existing checkout paths
Exports updated in packages/core/src/index.ts to include expandSparseCheckout
Unit test: expandSparseCheckout adds paths without removing existing ones
Unit test: ClonedSource includes cachePath and sparseCheckout fields
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: ClonedSource interface is at git-clone.ts lines 15-19 (currently: localPath, fromCache, sha). Add cachePath: string and sparseCheckout: boolean. CloneOptions is at lines 8-13. cloneGitSource() is at line 56. The function has two return paths: (1) cache hit around line 85-95 where it does git pull and returns, (2) fresh clone path around line 100-140. Both need to populate the new fields. For cachePath: this is the git repo root (cacheDir), NOT the subpath. For sparseCheckout: set true when options.subpath is defined (sparse-checkout is used). The expandSparseCheckout function should use simpleGit (already imported) — simpleGit(cachePath).raw(['sparse-checkout', 'add', ...additionalPaths]). Export block in core/src/index.ts is at lines 50-55 — add expandSparseCheckout to that block. Test file should be git-clone.test.ts co-located. Mock simpleGit for unit tests.

userStories.title: Thread CloneContext through profile chain resolution
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the profile chain resolver to know when it's operating inside a sparse-checkout repo so it can expand the checkout when resolving extends paths.
acceptanceCriteria: New CloneContext interface defined and exported from packages/core/src/inheritance/profile-chain.ts: { cachePath: string; sparseCheckout: boolean }
resolveProfileChain() accepts an optional 4th parameter cloneContext?: CloneContext
resolveChainRecursive() accepts and propagates cloneContext through all recursive calls
loadProfileFromSource() accepts an optional 3rd parameter cloneContext?: CloneContext

When loadProfileFromSource fails with a file-not-found error for a local provider path AND cloneContext.sparseCheckout is true: compute relative path from cachePath, call expandSparseCheckout(), and retry the load
If the retry also fails (parent truly doesn't exist), throw a hard error (not silently skip)
CloneContext exported from packages/core/src/index.ts
Unit test: chain resolution with CloneContext expands sparse-checkout and loads parent
Unit test: chain resolution without CloneContext (local sources) works unchanged
Unit test: missing parent in sparse-checkout repo throws hard error after expansion attempt
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: profile-chain.ts signatures: resolveProfileChain() at lines 36-40 (3 params: manifest, source, baseDir — add 4th optional cloneContext). resolveChainRecursive() at lines 61-69 (8 params including localPath — add 9th optional cloneContext). loadProfileFromSource() at lines 138-141 (2 params: source, baseDir — add 3rd optional cloneContext). The retry logic in loadProfileFromSource: when it catches a file-not-found error AND cloneContext?.sparseCheckout is true, compute the relative path using node:path.relative(cloneContext.cachePath, absoluteTargetPath) to get the repo-relative path (e.g. 'profiles/base'), then call expandSparseCheckout(cloneContext.cachePath, [relativePath]), then retry the load. Import expandSparseCheckout from ../sources/git-clone.js. Export block for profile-chain in core/src/index.ts is at lines 187-191 — add type CloneContext. Must run 'bun run build' before 'bun run typecheck' since CLI resolves @baton-dx/core from dist/.

userStories.title: Replace silent error swallowing with hard errors for extends resolution failures
userStories.description: As a profile author, I want to be notified immediately when an extends target cannot be resolved so I can fix the issue, instead of having the parent silently dropped.
acceptanceCriteria: The catch block in resolveChainRecursive() at profile-chain.ts no longer silently swallows file-not-found and general errors
CircularInheritanceError and max-depth errors continue to be re-thrown (existing behavior preserved)
All other errors from loadProfileFromSource are now re-thrown with enhanced error message
The error message includes the child profile name, the extends value, and the underlying cause
Unit test: missing extends target throws descriptive error
Unit test: circular inheritance still throws CircularInheritanceError
Unit test: max depth error still throws
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: The catch block is at profile-chain.ts lines 106-115. Currently: re-throws CircularInheritanceError and max-depth errors, silently swallows everything else (comment says 'Skip missing parent profiles gracefully'). Change: instead of the empty catch-all at the bottom, re-throw a new Error with descriptive message like `Failed to resolve extends '${extendsValue}' from profile '${manifest.name}': ${error.message}`. The existing tests in profile-chain.test.ts should verify circular inheritance still works. Add new tests for the hard error case. IMPORTANT: This story modifies the same file as US-002 (profile-chain.ts). Since US-002 adds the sparse-checkout retry logic inside loadProfileFromSource, the catch block in resolveChainRecursive should now only catch errors that bubble up AFTER the retry attempt. The error flow is: loadProfileFromSource tries load → fails → if sparseCheckout, expands and retries → if retry also fails, throws → resolveChainRecursive catches and re-throws with context.

userStories.title: Add source cache staleness check with configurable TTL
userStories.description: As a developer running baton sync, I want sources to be automatically refreshed if the cache is older than a configurable threshold so I always sync against reasonably fresh data.
acceptanceCriteria: CloneOptions in git-clone.ts includes new optional field maxCacheAgeMs?: number
New private helper isCacheStale(cachePath: string, maxAgeMs: number): Promise<boolean> checks .git/FETCH_HEAD mtime, falls back to .git/HEAD mtime
When useCache: true and cache exists and is stale: perform git fetch --depth=1 origin + git reset --hard origin/<branch> instead of just git pull
When fetch fails (network issue): fall back to git pull --depth=1, then to stale cache with console.warn message
When cache is not stale: existing best-effort git pull behavior unchanged
Default TTL is 24 hours (86400000 ms)
Unit test: stale cache triggers fetch
Unit test: fresh cache skips fetch
Unit test: network failure falls back gracefully
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: CloneOptions is at git-clone.ts lines 8-13 — add maxCacheAgeMs?: number. The isCacheStale function: use stat from node:fs/promises (add to imports) to check mtime of path.join(cachePath, '.git', 'FETCH_HEAD'). If FETCH_HEAD doesn't exist (first clone without fetch), fall back to path.join(cachePath, '.git', 'HEAD'). Compare: (Date.now() - mtime.getTime()) > maxAgeMs. The stale cache refresh logic goes in the cache-hit branch of cloneGitSource() (around line 85-95). Current behavior: tries git pull, catches silently, returns from cache. New behavior: if maxCacheAgeMs is set AND isCacheStale returns true, try fetch+reset first, fall back to pull, fall back to stale cache with console.warn. If maxCacheAgeMs is NOT set or cache is fresh, keep existing git pull behavior. Import { stat } from 'node:fs/promises'. The ref for the reset is options.ref || 'HEAD'.

userStories.title: Fix profile discovery showing only 'base' during init and manage
userStories.description: As a developer running baton init or baton manage, I want to see all available profiles from a source so I can choose the correct one, not just 'base'.
acceptanceCriteria: loadProfileManifestSafe() distinguishes between ENOENT (file not found, return null silently) and schema validation errors (log console.warn, return null)
Schema validation errors include the profile path and the specific validation failure in the warning message
Profiles with valid manifests that include extends, skills, agents, commands fields all pass schema validation and appear in the selection list
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: loadProfileManifestSafe() is NOT in source-discovery.ts directly — it's in packages/core/src/sources/load-profile-safe.ts (imported at source-discovery.ts line 5). The function is at load-profile-safe.ts lines 14-32. It currently catches ALL errors and returns null silently. Fix: split the catch into two cases. (1) Check for ENOENT: if (error.code === 'ENOENT' || (error instanceof Error && error.message.includes('ENOENT'))) return null silently. (2) For Zod validation errors: if (error instanceof z.ZodError) log console.warn with profile path and error.issues, return null. (3) For other errors: also log console.warn with the error message and profile path. The likely root cause of the bug: profiles with 'extends', 'skills', 'agents', or 'commands' fields may be failing Zod validation and being silently dropped. Check the profileManifestSchema to ensure these fields are all declared. After US-001 of the previous Ralph run, agents was added. Check if extends is in the schema — it should be (it's the inheritance mechanism). loadProfileManifestSafe is not exported from core/src/index.ts — it's internal, used only by source-discovery.ts.
